# Zymbol

> Zymbol is a symbolic programming language with no words in its grammar. Every construct is a
> symbol — `?` is if, `@` is loop, `<~` is return, `#1` is true — so identifiers can
> be written in any human language and the program reads the same everywhere. It
> ships as a Rust interpreter (tree-walker plus a register VM), an LSP server and a
> VS Code extension. In development: v0.0.9, public alpha. Current download: v0.0.8 —
> there is no v0.0.9 tag or binary yet, so every install link hands you v0.0.8.
> Code is AGPL-3.0-only; manuals, examples and documentation are CC BY-SA 4.0.

Every page of this site is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`,
or swap the extension — `/install.html` → `/install.md`.

## Site

- [Home](https://zymbol-lang.org/index.md): the fourteen marks one at a time, how they join into operators, and a Mandelbrot written in symbols.
- [Install](https://zymbol-lang.org/install.md): binaries for Linux/Windows/macOS with SHA256, VS Code extension, build from source.
- [Playground](https://zymbol-lang.org/playground.md): the browser engine's exact capabilities and limits, deep-link format, example groups.
- [Releases](https://zymbol-lang.org/changelog.md): full changelog, v0.0.1 through v0.0.8, plus v0.0.9 as it is being written (unreleased).
- [pIqaD reference](https://zymbol-lang.org/piqad-reference.md): Klingon script, CSUR block U+F8D0–U+F8FF.
- [Overview](https://zymbol-lang.org/overview.md): the former front page — the showcase, the operator table, FizzBuzz in any human language, the manuals. Archived: accurate as of v0.0.8 and no longer updated.

## Language manual

Two generations are published, and the current one is the shorter list.

The v0.0.9 manual is at `/data/manuals/v009/manual_<code>.md`, written so far in
four languages — English, Spanish, Italian and Quechua. Every code block in it was
run through `zymbol check` and every claimed output verified against what the
program actually prints. This is the one the front page shows, and only to readers
whose language is among the four.

The older generation is at `/data/manuals/manual_<code>.md`, in 110 languages. It
was last revised for v0.0.5 and is not being updated; `overview.html` still serves
it. Where the two disagree, v009 is right, and the interpreter repository is
authoritative over both.

- [Manual (English, v0.0.9)](https://zymbol-lang.org/data/manuals/v009/manual_en.md): variables, control flow, collections, functions, modules, errors.
- [Manual (Spanish, v0.0.9)](https://zymbol-lang.org/data/manuals/v009/manual_es.md): the same manual in Spanish.
- [Manual (Italian, v0.0.9)](https://zymbol-lang.org/data/manuals/v009/manual_it.md) · [Manual (Quechua, v0.0.9)](https://zymbol-lang.org/data/manuals/v009/manual_qu.md)
- [Manual (English, v0.0.5)](https://zymbol-lang.org/data/manuals/manual_en.md): the older generation, one of 110 languages.

## Embedding the engine

- [LLM.md](https://zymbol-lang.org/LLM.md): the browser engine (`zyjs`) for agents — what it does not have that the CLI does (shell, `std/db`, a real filesystem, a terminal), and a complete, verified Node host: `runZymbol` arguments, the module-resolver and TUI contracts, execution limits, and running a `.zyp`.

## Skill

- [write-zymbol](https://zymbol-lang.org/.well-known/agent-skills/write-zymbol/SKILL.md): the skill to load before writing Zymbol — syntax, and the mistakes that parse but behave wrong. Indexed at [/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://zymbol-lang.org/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) with a SHA-256 digest.

## Source

- [Interpreter](https://github.com/zymbol-lang/interpreter): Rust workspace, 19 crates. `GUIDE.md` is the authoritative language reference, `REFERENCE.md` the complete symbol table and limitations, `ARCHITECTURE.md` the crate catalog.
- [VS Code extension](https://github.com/zymbol-lang/vscode): TypeScript LSP client.
- [This site](https://github.com/zymbol-lang/web): static HTML/CSS/JS, no build step; `src/zymbol/zymbol.js` is a hand-maintained JavaScript mirror of the tree-walker.

## Optional

- [auth.md](https://zymbol-lang.org/auth.md): there is nothing to authenticate — no accounts, no keys, no API. Read this instead of probing for a sign-up flow.
- [Sitemap](https://zymbol-lang.org/sitemap.xml): the HTML pages.
- [Sharing guide](https://zymbol-lang.org/docs/SHARING.md): how playground links are built.
- [News](https://x.com/ZymbolLang): release announcements.
